name: Restart sampler (Neo)
plain: Karras restart: runs a Heun pass, then re-noises back up to a higher sigma and repeats a segment. When no list is given it picks restart counts from the step count.
math:
No list given and steps≥20: restart_steps=9,times=1 (steps≥36: steps//4, 2), base Karras over remaining; restart_list={0.1:[restart_steps+1,times,2]}.
Steps list inserts Karras segments from σ_restart_max=2 to σ=0.1. On each upward jump: x+=randn·s·√(σ_old²−σ_last²). Each segment: Heun step.
label: from code
surprise: It replaces the incoming sigmas with new Karras sigmas when steps≥20, ignoring the scheduler.
